title: Preservation of fanout reduction invariants
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative, integer, let $old$ be a finite list of Boolean gates, and let $g$ be another Boolean gate. Suppose a gate list, vertex map, and count satisfy the fanout reduction invariants for $old$. Suppose also that appending $g$ to $old$ preserves acyclicity, and that $g$ has distinct arguments, has at most two arguments, and has exactly one argument if it is a NOT gate. Then applying one fanout reduction step with $g$ yields a list, map, and count satisfying the fanout reduction invariants for the list obtained by appending $g$ to $old$.
hypotheses_covered: The given state satisfies the fanout reduction invariants for $old$
$old$ with $g$ appended is acyclic relative to $n$
If $g$ is a NOT gate, it has exactly one argument
